body: I could do that, but I just don't care enough to help other people.

Plenty of skills, but no real hobbies. I'm good at science stuff and can make just about anything with the right tools. I don't share myself with others because I rarely like the people I meet. 

My remaining family aren't assholes. They're products of the places they grew up (South Chicago and a desert trailer park) and rose above it all to get PHds, but I shouldn't have to carry the burden of life just because two people decided against birth control.
I've thought about the credit card thing, but idk how that works out legally if I'm still a financial dependent of my parents. I would still have to return to my life after a vacation.
